patch_description: Add sparse pairwise factors for the two outgoing and two incoming links at each node. These factors estimate whether a pair of neighbors provides complementary service to the node’s traffic, while also discouraging an uneven split of that traffic. Decomposing the estimated pair cost into linear endpoint effects and a sparse residual lets the QUBO capture this signal without adding a dense set of couplings. The budget of `n // 4` pairs per node and direction keeps the interactions compact; the strength is scaled by average direct-link score and node traffic.
